note: The current 2026/27 squad from the project's working spreadsheet. This is game-design/current-season data, NOT club history, and it is loaded as an ordinary season squad so that nothing downstream has to know the difference — except that its source names it as working data. Names are stored as the spreadsheet writes them; where a spelling differs from the all-time roster the importer's alias check reports it rather than merging by guess. The separate ranking/market-value sheet is deliberately NOT imported: a modern valuation is not a historical fact.
